UV disinfection will be a new disinfection process used at the Saugus WRP to reduce chloride discharge to the Santa Clara River...SCVSD installed the UV disinfection system at the Saugus WRP on July 20, 2021

Hypochlorite and ammonia are used to disinfect treated effluent at the Saugus WRP prior to discharging the effluent to the Santa Clara River...the chloramination disinfection system will be retained as a backup disinfection process.
Treated wastewater discharged to Santa Clara River is dechlorinated with sodium bisulfite, to remove residual chlorine when chloramines are used as the disinfecting agent.

Biosolids from both the Valencia and the Saugus WRPs are processed at the Valencia WRP and hauled offsite. Waste activated sludge from both the Saugus and Valencia WRPs is thickened by dissolved air flotation.
Thickened waste activated sludge and primary sludge are combined, digested anaerobically, dewatered and then reused through composting
